info.title: MAVLink telemetry router ingestion contract
info.description: Implementation contract for a receiving server. The repository diagnostic server supports only weather and heartbeat envelopes, lacks authentication/dedup/database, and rejects general schema3/bundle/CSV2. This document does not claim that full backend exists.

servers.description: Deployment base URL. Configure the router URL to this deployment; no public endpoint is supplied.

post.summary: Accept all enclosed record IDs; reply204 only after acceptance
post.description: Request Content-Type is application/json over HTTP/HTTPS TCP. Authentication may be absent in local tests or use Authorization: Bearer from the configured token_env. No HMAC, JWT format, request hash, or Idempotency-Key header is implemented. Retry bodies can add later queued records, change bundle wrapping, and update cumulative loss diagnostics; the full request bytes are not an identity. Deduplicate immutable records by schema-specific IDs before applying data. General schema3 uses(stream,session,batch_id); weather uses(stream,record.session,record.seq); heartbeat uses(stream,record.session,record.seq); development CSV2 uses(stream,session,window_us). Separately upsert spatial cumulative revisions by sender/session+continuity_key+path_id+bin_index+metric/message_id/sensor_id/sensor_instance/source_kind; replace with a newer revision rather than summing partials. Only204 releases client RAM items. TCP ACK and other2xx do not. Unknown object fields must be tolerated/preserved; an unknown top-level schema version needs an explicit server upgrade.

requestBody.description: Default0.10.0 compiled capacities. General key/value unit_map is display metadata, not SI conversion. Weather SI registry1 fixes temperature K and relative-humidity ratio. All stored examples are synthetic fixtures, not observations.

unknownWeather.summary: Synthetic C-serializer fixture; no actual observation

gpsSpatial.summary: Synthetic C-serializer fixture; no actual observation

mixedBundle.summary: Synthetic C-serializer fixture; no actual observation

204.description: Only application ACK: every enclosed immutable ID has been accepted durably by the deployment, or an existing duplicate is already accepted. Sender releases those queued items. The bundled diagnostic server only confirms RAM parsing/display; it provides no durable storage.

200.description: Not an ACK for this router. The sender retains queued items and retries.

202.description: Not an ACK, even if processing was accepted asynchronously. The sender retains queued items and retries until204.

400.description: Invalid request; sender retains/retries subject to its bounded queue and failure policy. Server must not ACK malformed data.

401.description: Deployment requires or rejects authentication. Sender retains/retries; configure the token environment variable.

413.description: Deployment request-size limit exceeded; not an ACK. Current sender wire body can reach1,110,015 bytes; diagnostic server limit is512KiB.

429.description: Rate limited; not an ACK. No Retry-After-specific scheduling behavior is promised by the current client.

default.description: Every status except204, connection failure and lost response leaves unconfirmed immutable items queued. Queues are finite, RAM-only and can lose later input on overflow/restart.

bearerAuth.description: Optional deployment authentication. Current client reads the bearer token from token_env; configuration files retain only the variable name.
